metadata.title: Privacy Policy — PRESTIGO Premium Chauffeur Prague
metadata.description: How PRESTIGO collects, uses, and protects your personal data. GDPR-compliant privacy policy for our premium chauffeur service in Prague and Central Europe.
metadata.ogTitle: Privacy Policy — PRESTIGO Premium Chauffeur Prague

section2.title: What Data We Collect
section2.intro: We collect only what is necessary to provide our services.

bookingForm.heading: Booking form
bookingForm.text: First name, last name, email, phone number, flight number, pickup and drop-off addresses, date and time, vehicle preference, child seat request, special requests.

contactForm.heading: Contact form
contactForm.text: Name, email, phone number, service type, message.

corporateEnquiry.heading: Corporate enquiry
corporateEnquiry.text: Company name, contact name and role, email, estimated monthly trips, notes.

automaticallyCollected.heading: Automatically collected
automaticallyCollected.text: IP address, browser type and version, device type, pages visited, referring URL, and interaction data — collected via Google Analytics.

locationData.heading: Location data
locationData.text: Pickup and destination addresses you enter are processed via the Google Maps API for route calculation and autocomplete. We do not track your real-time location.

section3.title: Legal Basis for Processing
section3.intro: We process your personal data under the following legal bases defined in Article 6 of the GDPR:

performanceOfContract.heading: Performance of a contract — Art. 6(1)(b)
performanceOfContract.text: Processing your booking data to arrange and fulfil your transfer, processing payment, sending booking confirmations, and providing driver contact details.

legitimateInterest.heading: Legitimate interest — Art. 6(1)(f)
legitimateInterest.text: Website analytics to improve our service, fraud prevention, and responding to your enquiries via the contact form.

legalObligation.heading: Legal obligation — Art. 6(1)(c)
legalObligation.text: Retaining booking and payment records as required by Czech tax and accounting regulations.

section4.title: Third-Party Service Providers
section4.intro: We share personal data only with trusted service providers who process it on our behalf and under our instructions.

providers.name: Stripe
providers.purpose: Payment processing. Card data is sent directly to Stripe — PRESTIGO never stores your card number.

providers.name: Google Analytics
providers.purpose: Anonymised website usage statistics to help us improve our service.

providers.name: Supabase
providers.purpose: Secure database hosting for booking records (EU region).

providers.name: Resend
providers.purpose: Transactional email delivery — booking confirmations and driver details.

section5.title: International Data Transfers
section5.text: Your booking data is stored within the European Union (Supabase EU region). Some of our service providers — including Google, Stripe, Resend, and Vercel — may process data in the United States. These transfers are protected by the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and, where applicable, Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.

items.period: 5 years from the date of the transfer, as required by Czech tax and accounting regulations.
12 months after your enquiry has been resolved.
PRESTIGO stores only the transaction reference ID. Full payment data is retained by Stripe in accordance with their retention policy.

section7.title: Cookies
section7.intro: Our website uses a limited number of cookies:

cookies.name: _ga / _gid
cookies.purpose: Google Analytics — anonymised usage statistics. Expire after 2 years / 24 hours respectively.

cookies.name: Essential cookies
cookies.purpose: Session management only. Required for the website to function correctly.

section7.outro: We do not use advertising, remarketing, or social media tracking cookies.

section8.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
section8.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the following rights:

rights.desc: Obtain a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
Request that we limit the processing of your data.
Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Object to processing based on legitimate interest.
Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting prior processing.

section8.outroPrefix: To exercise any of these rights, email

section10.title: Changes to This Policy
section10.text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The “last updated” date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of our services after any changes constitutes your acknowledgement of the updated policy.
